text:
maria: Quick sync — we need the final changelog link + docs anchors for Wed's benchmark webinar. Also need the canonical benchmark narrative (TL;DR + methodology) for the blog and slides. And: what's the rollout timing? full -> canary -> global? @ajay @caroline

ajay: Plan is canary 5% Mon 9am PT, 20% Tue, 100% Wed 1pm PT. If metrics look good we can accelerate.

caroline: Docs are up: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-benchmarks#results and changelog at https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/2026-03-16. I still need the short "how we measured" blurb to land the methodology anchor.

sam: For webinar signups — do new leads get a tag 'bench-webinar' in CRM? Need routing to growth SDRs and the 1-sentence summary for the registration email.

ajay: Canary controlled via FF 'bench_v2_rollout'. Ops will run the rollout script: ```./rollout.sh --flag bench_v2_rollout --steps 5%,20%,100% --wait 30m``` Ops will post status. Fallback to v1 if error rate >1%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary step 1 started 1824004800 — 5% traffic to bench_v2.

elaine: Adding SLO watch: alert if error rate increases >0.5% and p95 latency spike. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/bench-ops

maria: For the narrative, call out: ~30% cost reduction via KV caching + ~10ms median latency improvement. Ajay, do those match the internal evals?

ajay: Internal evals show cost per 1k tokens down 28–32% depending on seq length. Median latency improvement ~9–12ms. I'll paste short bullets.

ajay: Bullets: - Methodology: 50k synthetic queries + 10k sampled prod traces (median seq 128 tokens). - Results: ~30% unit cost reduction, p50 ~-10ms, p95 ~-25ms. - Caveats: model-dependent; long tails vary.

caroline: Updated docs paragraph and methodology anchor inserted. Pasted snippet into the docs page — feel free to tweak wording.

sam: Email blurb suggestion: "New inference runtime reduces cost ~30% while improving latency — join our webinar for live demos and benchmarks."

maria: Final asks: pin changelog link in #marketing and drop final assets into the comms folder by EOD Monday. @ajay @caroline please confirm. :pray:

ajay: Will ping here when canary hits 20% and again at 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary step 2 started 1824004950 — 20% traffic to bench_v2.

elaine: 20% stable, no error spike, latency within expected bounds. :thumbsup:
